# interval finishes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalFinishes`](gmeow-intervalFinishes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalFinishes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

Allen FINISHES: this interval and the related interval end together, and this one began later. NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalFinishedBy`](gmeow-intervalFinishedBy.md). (= [time:intervalFinishes](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalFinishes))
